data: NVIDIA reported fiscal 2024 revenue of $60,922 million (about $60.9 billion) for the year ended January 28, 2024, up from $26,974 million in fiscal 2023, which is growth of roughly 126%, or about $33.9 billion. Net income was $29,760 million (about $29.8 billion), compared with $4,368 million in fiscal 2023, an increase of around 581%. Diluted earnings per share rose to $11.93 from $1.74. The jump reflected gross profit climbing to $44,301 million from $15,356 million, while operating expenses grew only modestly to $11,329 million from $11,132 million, with fiscal 2023 also including a $1,353 million acquisition termination cost.
